reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a PAGE clause is written, an omitted HEADING gives integer-2 = 1, an omitted FIRST DETAIL gives integer-3 = integer-2, LAST DETAIL and FOOTING both omitted give integer-4 = integer-5 = integer-1, FOOTING alone gives integer-4 = integer-5, LAST DETAIL alone gives integer-5 = integer-4; the 1985 clause has no LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase (control headings are bounded by integer-4), so that 2002 phrase must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ReportPageForms2002: refuses LAST CONTROL HEADING, the DE abbreviation and IS before a phrase integer below 2002

reader.edition-search: The defaults themselves (BindReportDescriptionClauses lines 259-265) have no edition arm; at 85 the LAST CONTROL HEADING default reduces to LAST DETAIL / FOOTING / integer-1, which is 1985's integer-4 per GR2c-e, and GroupLimits bounds CH by it.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: 1985 has no LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase (refused) and integer-1 is limited to three digits; the defaults for the five 1985 integers are the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c20 covers a, b with HEADING = 1, c, d, e via body-group fit; b with HEADING written, and the page footing's region after a defaulted integer-5, were not exercised

reader.notes: The defaults are computed once in BindReportDescriptionClauses and emitted into the runtime's constructor. The order and range diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers and name LAST CONTROL HEADING even at 85, which is only a wording matter.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the consequences of each default at --std 85 (refute-1985-039): p2ph (PAGE 10 HEADING 2, FIRST DETAIL omitted -> integer-3 = integer-2 = 2, so the PH region 2..1 is empty, SR8b) -> PH LINE 2 refused COBOL2199; p2pf and p2rf (LAST DETAIL and FOOTING omitted -> integer-4 = integer-5 = integer-1 = 10, so the PF/RF region 11..10 is empty, SR8e/f) -> PF LINE 10 and a relative RF both refused COBOL2199; p2cf (LAST DETAIL 6 alone -> integer-5 = 6, GR2e) -> CF LINE 7 refused, p2cf6 CF LINE 6 compiles and prints on line 6 of the last page; p2de (FOOTING 8 alone -> integer-4 = 8, GR2d) -> DE LINE 8 legal, presented on line 8 of each page; p2run (PAGE 6 HEADING 2, nothing else) -> details on lines 2-6, five per page, form feed after each fifth.
